csv_agency: Bowling Green State University Purchasing Dept
csv_scope_of_work: Bowling Green State University (BGSU) is requesting qualifications from interested firms to provide Architectural/Engineering (A/E) design services for the renovation of Hayes Hall. Through this renovation, BGSU seeks to preserve an important historic campus asset while creating a welcoming, sustainable, accessible, and technologically advanced environment that supports students, faculty, and staff for decades to come.

title: A/E Services for Hayes Hall Renovation
short_description: Design services for sustainable renovation of the historic Hayes Hall university building.
project_scope: Renovation of Hayes Hall at Bowling Green State University to preserve a historic campus building and create a welcoming, sustainable, accessible, and technologically advanced environment for students, faculty, and staff. The stated total construction cost is 14.4 million USD. No gross floor area or further technical building characteristics are provided.
services: Architectural and engineering design services for building renovation, including architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, fire protection engineering, utility engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- University project, which is generally of strategic interest.
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary A/E design scope.
- However, this is a renovation/refurbishment project rather than a new complex structure.
- No long spans, special structural systems, or architecturally exceptional features are described.
- Strong focus appears to be on general building renovation and full-service A/E delivery rather than a distinct structural challenge for sbp.
